roads.name: Zink Ranch Road
words: Sweeping and steady: 39 curves in 9.0 miles.
About 1.9 miles in the middle are tamer.
The 3 miles at the south end are tamer.
From 727 to 979 ft, with 1,115 ft of up and down along the way.
July highs average 92°F.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 25 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.29 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
